description: Source code implementing management handlers for Zephyr settings group, including read, write, delete, load, save, and commit operations with callback and access control mechanisms.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_read
methods.description: Handles reading a setting value based on a key, with access control and error handling.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_write
methods.description: Handles writing a value to a setting identified by a key, with access control and error handling.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_delete
methods.description: Handles deleting a setting identified by a key, with access control and error handling.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_commit
methods.description: Handles committing settings changes, with access control.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_load
methods.description: Handles loading settings from persistent storage, with access control.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_save
methods.description: Handles saving settings to persistent storage, with access control.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_translate_error_code
methods.description: Translates internal error codes to management protocol error codes, if protocol support is enabled.

methods.name: settings_mgmt_register_group
methods.description: Registers the settings management group with the management subsystem.
